correctness.rationale: An obstruction equivalence characterizes all failed cascades; a seven-state finite automaton counts complements without overcounting; rational inversion exactly produces the bivariate formula, and a coefficientwise scaling plus dominant-pole extraction prove all universal results. Tests are not presented as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The size-resolved reliability is motivated by finite-network social intervention: at each exact adopter budget it counts successful campaigns, yields all iid-initialization probabilities, gives a sharp minimum budget with multiplicity and a large-width-fixed population growth law. This is a complete classification of a simple but nontrivial spatial network, not an arbitrary finite computation. Extrapolation to empirical diffusion or different widths is not made.
